description: This header defines the interface for the SSP message bus, including initialization, finalization, bus check, resource cleanup, and engagement functions. It specifies external function declarations used for message bus setup and management within the software component.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_MessageBusEngage
methods.description: Engages or initializes the message bus with specified component ID, configuration file, and path.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the message bus or related subsystem with user-defined data.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_Finalize
methods.description: Performs cleanup and finalization routines for the message bus with user data.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_Buscheck
methods.description: Checks the status or health of the message bus with user data.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_FreeResources
methods.description: Frees or releases resources associated with the message bus, given a priority and user data.
